scope: Public pages discovered through menus, footer and internal body links. Embedded videos, image-only assets and every linked document were not exhaustively audited. Sitemaps were unavailable.

pages.title: Home
pages.decision: Keep accessible, useful computing and broad participation. Replace machine-led income claims with demand-led services, transparent costs and optional hardware.

pages.title: Press
pages.decision: Create a verified progress journal. Separate measured results from proposed products, financial scenarios and unrelated political commentary.

pages.title: Founders
pages.decision: Use verified, consented biographies and a precise voting map. Founder control must be reconciled with member rights; a website does not amend corporate governance.

pages.title: Get started
pages.decision: Begin with a useful service and a clear price. Remove the assumption that participants should finance equipment or pay a lease-back subscription to gain opportunity.

pages.title: Field reports
pages.decision: Keep evidence trails and bounded AI authority. Replace unsupported government, financing and acquisition assertions with reproducible results and documented agreements.

pages.title: Finance
pages.decision: Separate service access, hardware purchase and financing. Clearly disclose delivery timing, total payment obligations and risk. Do not rely on speculative income to justify debt.

pages.title: Business plan
pages.decision: Keep productive services, professional networks and wider participation. Purchases are revenue, not automatically investable surplus; full reimbursement needs a demonstrated funding source.

pages.title: Market cap
pages.decision: Speculative token valuation is not evidence of customer demand, company value or available capital. The redesigned business does not require a multi-token economy.

pages.title: Corporate charter
pages.decision: Preserve clear legal entities and responsibilities. Corporate age alone establishes neither financial credibility nor access to every funding pathway.

pages.title: Publications
pages.decision: Create a sourced library separating independent publications, company essays, concept imagery and proposed products. Confirm original publishers and actual endorsements.

pages.title: Commerce
pages.decision: Keep interoperable transaction records. Remove universal currency pegs, fixed economy-wide revenue allocations and assumed authority over taxes or national policy.

pages.title: Onboarding
pages.decision: Keep patient human support. Make service terms and costs clear; access should not require a wallet, token purchase or expensive hardware.

pages.title: Buy now
pages.decision: If hardware is offered later, publish exact specifications, delivery, warranty and a workload-based value comparison. This concept site offers no checkout.

pages.title: Affiliate
pages.decision: Defer high-value hardware referral incentives. Any later sales program should disclose commissions and reward delivered customer value rather than recruitment.

pages.title: Community
pages.decision: Retain education, cooperation and support. Broaden participation to people who cannot invest or buy equipment; allow disagreement and open criticism.

pages.title: White paper
pages.decision: Keep modular coordination and auditable records. Remove unverified valuation, automatic universal compliance and discriminatory narratives. Tokens do not confer democratic legitimacy.

pages.title: Pitch deck
pages.decision: Lead with customer, workflow, price, evidence and execution. Replace token-upside comparisons and universal tax claims with a bounded commercial proposition.

pages.title: Research
pages.decision: Retain serious inquiry into work, income, AI and household costs. Publish methods, complete references, uncertainty, revisions and criticism.

pages.title: 9/11 redemption
pages.decision: Remove unrelated geopolitical and authority claims from the commercial vision. Preserve civilian welfare and peaceful cooperation as universal commitments.

pages.title: More press
pages.decision: Keep useful paid work and recurring services. Test distributed compute against actual alternatives; remain open to income support for people unable to contribute labor.

pages.title: Testimonials
pages.decision: Remove discriminatory and conspiratorial narratives. Future customer stories require consent, attribution and evidence of actual outcomes.

pages.title: Sustainability
pages.decision: Keep education and critical thinking. Add actual energy, equipment-life and resource measures; learning access must not depend on speculative participation.

pages.title: Investment
pages.decision: Separate investment materials from ordinary services. Claims about financial terms, eligibility and authority need their own documented review; this site solicits no investment.

pages.title: Proprietary systems
pages.decision: Do not treat speculative physical-instantiation or broad patent-style descriptions as working infrastructure. Retain ordinary authentication only where implemented and tested.

pages.title: Accountability
pages.decision: Translate the useful concern into audit trails, complaints, due process and independent review. Separate contested litigation advocacy from claims about the product.

pages.title: Quantitative
pages.decision: Keep attention to AI orchestration and verifiable execution. Replace deterministic legal/financial correctness claims and unsourced forecasts with reproducible task-level evaluations.

pages.title: Roadmap
pages.decision: Retain clear onboarding. Replace machine-to-return progression with a customer pilot, evidence gates, transparent costs and a right to exit.

pages.title: Leadership
pages.decision: Replace political-personality positioning with accountable organizational roles, qualifications, succession and member representation.

pages.title: Economic framework
pages.decision: Keep fair pay and responsibility for risk. A universal 80/20 allocation cannot fit every industry; the stated wage increase needs additional cost-share assumptions.

pages.title: Decal program
pages.decision: Defer compensated advertising until there is a useful service and a funded campaign. Large promotional payouts do not validate the underlying economics.

pages.title: Decentralization
pages.decision: Replace geopolitical restructuring and currency-authority claims with practical local control, provider choice, portable records and accountable federation.

pages.title: Partners
pages.decision: A possible acquisition target is not a partner. Publish only documented relationships and their actual scope; cooperation should be voluntary.

pages.title: Mujahideen
pages.decision: Preserve education, pluralism and civilian dignity. Retire military or sovereign-authority framing from a private economic platform.

pages.title: News briefings
pages.decision: Keep unrelated geopolitical video commentary out of primary product navigation. A research archive must distinguish interpretation from verified evidence.

pages.title: Biometric identity
pages.decision: Use data minimization and non-biometric access. Remove identity-purchase incentives, compulsory token holdings and broad collection of sensitive identifiers.

pages.title: Strategic deployment
pages.decision: Keep useful local hubs as an option. Begin with rented capacity; occupancy, power and customer demand must justify property and compute investment independently.

pages.title: Market intelligence
pages.decision: Replace sweeping predictions, promotional valuations and unsupported authority claims with dated evidence, uncertainty and clear separation of analysis from operations.

pages.title: Become a member
pages.decision: Distinguish service access, governance membership and investment. Provide clear terms and collect only necessary data when a real service launches.

pages.title: Music
pages.decision: Keep creator attribution and royalty administration. Require actual permissions, licenses and evidence of use; embedded media does not establish a partnership.

pages.title: Silk Road
pages.decision: Keep cross-border collaboration as a horizon. Expand through willing local partners and proven demand, without claiming an operational global corridor.

pages.title: Religion
pages.decision: Protect freedom of belief and conscience for everyone. Optional theological essays should not function as platform rules or evidence for financial mechanisms.

pages.title: Disclaimer
pages.decision: Replace broad disclaimers with accurate product-level claims, full costs, risk and clear rights. Describing something as technology does not settle its financial character.

pages.title: Lease-back
pages.decision: Any future compute arrangement needs metered useful work, transparent fees, payment timing and customer demand. A recurring operator charge does not create a reliable income stream.

pages.title: Institutional systems
pages.decision: Defer large hardware sales until specifications, demand, lifecycle costs, delivery and support are independently assessable.

pages.title: Home
pages.decision: Preserve broad participation, useful infrastructure and claims accountability. Remove exclusivity-as-decentralization, unsupported authority, hostile narratives and unverified endorsements.

pages.title: Membership subscription
pages.decision: Separate a service subscription from capital placed in a fund. The new public vision contains no liquidity-facility enrollment or investment checkout.

pages.title: Field reports
pages.decision: Keep evidence preservation and due process. Build a clear audit, correction and complaint process; separate unrelated case advocacy.

pages.title: Finance tool
pages.decision: A planner can organize goals, costs and funding gaps. It cannot supply capital or establish creditworthiness merely by calculating a number.

pages.title: Strategy
pages.decision: Keep productive ownership and cooperation. Replace return positioning, bank-acquisition ambition, discriminatory claims and implied public authority with a bounded service strategy.

pages.title: Press
pages.decision: Create a verified progress journal. The premium-funded purchase-reimbursement example has a funding-base problem; replace it with earned-surplus rebates.

pages.title: Business model
pages.decision: Reinvesting real operating cash flow is coherent. Infinite-growth or self-sustaining-liquidity claims need to give way to costs, demand, reserves and downside cases.

pages.title: Advantage
pages.decision: Keep reduced coordination friction. Replace paying extra today for assumed future reimbursement with useful services, immediate savings and disclosed fees.

pages.title: Intermetanet
pages.decision: Keep permissions, settlement records, contractual administration and royalties. The page correctly separates settlement from financing; narrow the universal allocation and platform-control claims.

pages.title: Research
pages.decision: Institutional drift is a valuable research theme. Turn it into protected rights, explicit amendment rules, independent review and meaningful exit.

pages.title: Postdoctoral research
pages.decision: Preserve relevant scholarship with original publication links. Academic expertise does not itself validate a commercial or financial mechanism.

pages.title: Peer evaluations
pages.decision: Make criticism visible. Extend this norm to economics, technical tests and governance, with responses and revisions rather than implied commercial endorsement.

pages.title: Positioning
pages.decision: Prioritize voluntary opportunity matching and fairly paid local verification. Replace a living census or surveillance framing with user-controlled profiles and explicit consent.

pages.title: Real estate
pages.decision: Standardized property information and professional coordination address concrete needs. Preserve homeowner choice and equity; measure housing outcomes beyond sale price.

pages.title: Counsel
pages.decision: Publish verified roles, qualifications and actual relationships. Remove implied institutional endorsement and unrelated authority claims; provide independent complaint review.

pages.title: Justice
pages.decision: Translate due process into notice, reasons, human review and remedies. Keep disputed case claims separate from the service.

pages.title: Mission
pages.decision: Retain cooperation across cultural differences. Anchor it in practical abilities to learn, work, create, trade and obtain fair treatment.

pages.title: MVP
pages.decision: Retain MREO-first sequencing and revenue before expansion. Start with coordination; property acquisition, lending and exchange operation are separate undertakings.

pages.title: Terrorism
pages.decision: Remove conspiracy and religious-hostility framing. Narrow fraud controls and lawful evidence review do not confer policing or national-security authority.

pages.title: Safe harbor
pages.decision: Preserve equal safety and dignity for Jewish, Palestinian and all other communities, including people without a faith. Make nondiscrimination, privacy and assistance operational.

pages.title: Surplus
pages.decision: Distinguish company profit, household income, public fiscal balance and money creation. Share actual net earnings; perpetual surplus is not a software feature.

pages.title: Disclaimer
pages.decision: State which capabilities exist and what participants own. Separate service terms, privacy, governance and any properly reviewed financial documents.
